notes.title: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined is available for pre-purchase now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2499860/

"There's more to the world than this island... And we're going to prove it!"

Set sail on an adventure spanning past and present in DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined!

As a bright-eyed young fisherman's son, you've lived your entire life on the peaceful island of Estard. Your journey begins with a simple question: is there more to the world than this small island kingdom?

On a quest for answers, you and your childhood friends discover the Shrine of Mysteries and are swept back in time. There, you uncover the shocking truth that entire lands have been sealed away by a malevolent force.

The fate of the world now rests in your hands.

DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined brings a timeless classic to life in a whole new way with charming diorama visuals, updated gameplay mechanics, and a streamlined story,.

For seasoned adventurers, rediscover a tale of plucky companions that is brimming with joy and heartbreak. For fledgling heroes new to the series, this is a great place to begin your DRAGON QUEST journey.


[h3]Early Bird Bonus[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857501/a0b429219443c0f577e9498949509ca7111475a1.png[/img]
Purchase DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined early and receive a costume for your Hero along with other helpful items.
[b][list]
[*] Trodain Togs (appearance changing costume for your Hero)
[*] Seed of Proficiency x3[/list][/b]
*These items will only be available to customers who purchase the game by 16:59 BST / 08:59 PDT on March 5th 2026.
*The "Seed of Proficiency" is an item that can be obtained by progressing in the game.
*These bonus items can be received from the "Claim Special Rewards" menu in-game.



[h3]Purchase Bonus[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857501/f6caf47959e5683fb166228ceb72b50dbd461c27.png[/img]
[b][list]
[*] Silver Slime Shield[/list][/b]
*This bonus item can be received from the "Claim Special Rewards" menu in-game.



[h3]DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined Digital Deluxe Edition[/h3]
Includes the full game, "Additional DLC Sets", and 48 hours of early access to the full game. Embark on an epic adventure ahead of everybody else!

[b][Contents][/b]
[list]
[*] DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined base game
[*] DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined "Additional DLC Sets"
     Additional DLC - The Road of Regal Wretches
     Additional DLC - Luminary's Livery
     Additional DLC - Jam-Packed Swag Bag
[*] 48 hours of early access
[*] White Wolf Costume (Appearance changing costume for Ruff)
[/list]
*After the launch of DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined, the "Additional DLC Sets" and each additional DLC will also be available for individual purchase. Please be careful to avoid making duplicate purchases.
*Some items in the additional DLCs can also be obtained by progressing in the game.
*To play The Road of Regal Wretches, you will need to progress in the game and unlock the battle arena.
*The Road of Regal Wretches can be accessed by talking to the She-Slime at the battle arena reception desk.
*Contents such as the costumes and items can be received from the "Claim Special Rewards" menu in the game.

notes.title: DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake - Pre-order Now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893570/
DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake is a stunning reimagination of the first two legendary adventures in The Erdrick Trilogy, brought together in one package. 

Anyone who pre-orders the digital version of DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake will receive a free trouble-free travel kit in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065548/6e48f5b66578e6cb664bffb1b93dc0b976d9cbfe.png[/img]
[h3]The trouble-free travel kit contains:[/h3]
[list]
[*]  One pair of elevating shoes
[*]  Three seeds of strength
[*]  Three seeds of defence
[*]  Three seeds of agility
[*]  Three seeds of life
[*]  Three seeds of magic
[/list]
All these items can also be obtained by playing through the game.
All bonus in-game items can be acquired by opening the treasure chest at the inn in Tantegel for DRAGON QUEST I, or the treasure chest at the inn in Midenhall for DRAGON QUEST II.
*These items will be gifted to customers who purchase the game before 15:59 GMT / 08:59 PDT on October 30th 2025.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065548/885cb2943e385428d36acc30d09b80a4797507a1.png[/img]
Players with existing save data for DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake are entitled to the following bonus in-game items in both DRAGON QUEST I and DRAGON QUEST II*.

[h3]The marvellous makeover kit contains:[/h3]
[list]
[*]  DRAGON QUEST I: One dog suit
[*]  DRAGON QUEST II: One cat suit
[/list]
*These items can also be obtained by playing the game.

These bonus in-game items can be acquired by:
DRAGON QUEST I: Opening the chest inside the inn in Tantegel.
DRAGON QUEST II: Opening the chest inside the inn in Midenhall.
Your save data for DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake must be tied to the same account that you play DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake with for you to claim these rewards.
You are still eligible for these rewards if you start playing DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake after you have begun playing DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake.
This only applies to save data for DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake (2024), not DRAGON QUEST III: The Seeds of Salvation (2019).
These rewards are subject to change without notice.

notes.title: DRAGON QUEST XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age - Definitive Edition Out Today
notes.content:
DRAGON QUEST XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age - Definitive Edition is Out Today!

Enjoy the new content and features of DRAGON QUEST XI S today. Play in 2D or 3D mode, experience new scenarios, Japanese voices, orchestral music and much more. 

[previewyoutube=tOXK1rq1Y9k;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Story[/h2]

It was the day that you, the hero of this tale celebrated your 16th Birthday.
Together with your childhood friend Gemma, you climbed to the top of Cobblestone Tor, to perform the coming of age rites that are customary in your village. However, a mysterious incident lead you to discover that you are the reincarnation of the legendary "Luminary".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365799/22786ccb22fc27688b790785100e4ad0709cc771.jpg[/img]

[h2]What exactly is the "Luminary"?[/h2]

You decide to leave the village and set out on a journey into the unknown world to seek the answer.
However, the people seem to have no welcome for a young Luminary and decry you as the spawn of the devil, sealing your fate to be an outcast...

Jump into the beautiful world of Erdrea, unravel the mystery of your past and claim some bonus content rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365799/a3ac2ca53f0a525e4f3aa2cc6825ae1d0d523824.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy your time with DRAGON QUEST XI S.
